items.q: Mei has 3 bags. Each bag has 5 sweets. How many sweets does Mei have in all?
items.hint: Draw a box for each bag. Write the number of sweets in each box.

slips.say: 8 is 3 + 5. Draw 3 boxes with 5 in each box and add them.

tpl.q: Mei has {a} bags. Each bag has {b} sweets. How many sweets does Mei have in all?
tpl.hint: Draw a box for each bag. Write the number of sweets in each box.

items.q: Ali has 3 boxes with 5 pens in each box. He also has 2 loose pens. How many pens does Ali have in all?
items.hint: Find the pens in the boxes first. Then add the loose pens.

slips.say: 15 is the pens in the boxes. Add the 2 loose pens.

tpl.q: Ali has {a} boxes with {b} pens in each box. He also has {c} loose pens. How many pens does Ali have in all?
tpl.hint: Find the pens in the boxes first. Then add the loose pens.

items.q: Ravi has 4 bags with 3 marbles in each bag. He loses 2 marbles. How many marbles does Ravi have now?
items.hint: Find the marbles in the bags first. Then take away the marbles he loses.

slips.say: He loses marbles, so take away. Do not add.

tpl.q: Ravi has {a} bags with {b} marbles in each bag. He loses {c} marbles. How many marbles does Ravi have now?
tpl.hint: Find the marbles in the bags first. Then take away the marbles he loses.

items.q: Ali has 4 bags. Each bag has 5 sweets. Which number sentence finds how many sweets Ali has in all?
items.hint: 4 bags with 5 in each bag is 4 groups of 5.

slips.say: 4 + 5 joins the number of bags and the number of sweets. We need 4 groups of 5.

items.q: Mei has 6 stickers. Ali has twice as many stickers as Mei. How many stickers does Ali have?
items.hint: Ali’s strip is two strips the same as Mei’s.

slips.say: 8 is 6 + 2. Twice as many is two strips the same as Mei’s.

tpl.q: Mei has {m} stickers. Ali has twice as many stickers as Mei. How many stickers does Ali have?
tpl.hint: Ali’s strip is two strips the same as Mei’s.

items.q: Mei has 6 stickers. Ali has twice as many stickers as Mei. How many stickers do they have together?
items.hint: Find Ali’s stickers first. Then add Mei’s.

slips.say: 12 is Ali’s stickers. Add Mei’s stickers too.

tpl.q: Mei has {m} stickers. Ali has twice as many stickers as Mei. How many stickers do they have together?
tpl.hint: Find Ali’s stickers first. Then add Mei’s.

items.q: Mei has 8 stickers. Ravi has twice as many stickers as Mei. Jenny says Ravi has 10 stickers. Is Jenny correct?
items.hint: Twice as many is two strips the same as Mei’s. How many is that?
steps: Ravi has 16, not 10. Jenny is not correct.

slips.say: 10 is 8 + 2. Twice as many is two strips of 8.

items.q: Ali has twice as many cards as Mei. Ali has 24 cards. Ali gives some cards to Mei. Then they have the same number. How many cards does Ali give?
items.hint: Find Mei’s cards. The gap is shared equally.
steps: Ali gives half of the gap: 6 cards.

slips.say: 12 is the gap. Ali gives only half of the gap.

tpl.q: Ali has twice as many cards as Mei. Ali has {a} cards. Ali gives some cards to Mei. Then they have the same number. How many cards does Ali give?
tpl.hint: Find Mei’s cards. The gap is shared equally.
steps: The gap is {m}. Two equal parts of {m} are {ans} and {ans}.

items.q: Wei puts 3 stickers on each of 4 cards. He puts 2 stickers on each of 5 other cards. He also has 4 stickers in his hand. How many stickers did Wei have at first?
items.hint: Find the stickers on each set of cards. Then add the stickers in his hand.

slips.say: 22 is the stickers on the cards. Add the 4 left over.

tpl.q: Wei puts 3 stickers on each of {a} cards. He puts 2 stickers on each of {c} other cards. He also has {r} stickers in his hand. How many stickers did Wei have at first?
tpl.hint: Find the stickers on each set of cards. Then add the stickers in his hand.

items.q: Siti has 7 marbles. Ravi has 3 times as many marbles as Siti. How many marbles do they have altogether?
items.hint: Ravi’s strip is three strips the same as Siti’s.

slips.say: 21 is Ravi’s marbles. Add Siti’s marbles too.

tpl.q: Siti has {m} marbles. Ravi has 3 times as many marbles as Siti. How many marbles do they have altogether?
tpl.hint: Ravi’s strip is three strips the same as Siti’s.

items.q: Kumar has 3 times as many pens as Lily. They have 24 pens together. How many pens does Lily have?
items.hint: Draw 1 box for Lily and 3 boxes for Kumar. How many equal boxes in all?
steps: Lily has 1 box and Kumar has 3 boxes: 4 boxes.
24 pens in 4 equal boxes is 6 in each.

slips.say: 24 is shared into 4 equal boxes, not 3.

tpl.q: Kumar has 3 times as many pens as Lily. They have {t} pens together. How many pens does Lily have?
tpl.hint: Draw 1 box for Lily and 3 boxes for Kumar. How many equal boxes in all?
steps: Lily has 1 box and Kumar has 3 boxes: 4 boxes.
{t} pens in 4 equal boxes is {ans} in each.

items.q: Make up a strip story for a grown-up. Use bags and sweets, or twice as many. Many answers are right.
items.hint: Choose how many boxes and what is in each box first.
steps: Draw the boxes and write the number in each box.
Ask your grown-up for the total.
